_note: 科研時事（站點級，跨科目）。顯示在三科總覽頁。cat 用 bio/chem/phys/math，只影響標籤顏色。越新的排越前。內容必須來自可靠來源並附連結——時事不是常識，寧可少寫也不要編。每天從泛科學、ScienceDaily、Nature 主刊精選 8 篇（單一來源最多 3 篇、單一科目最多 3 篇），本檔由 scripts/fetch_news.py 自動產生，可手動補充。

items.t: 巧妙的分子技巧解鎖了玻璃中以前不可能的特性
items.x: 科學家發現如何使用一種特殊的分子重新編程玻璃的內部結構，該分子可以重新排列化學鍵，同時降低熔化溫度。這項突破可以解鎖具有精確控制的磁性和光學特性的全新玻璃材料，為先進電子、感測器和其他技術帶來可能性。
items.orig: A clever molecular trick unlocks previously impossible properties in glass
items.origX: Scientists have discovered how to reprogram the internal structure of glass using a special molecule that rearranges chemical bonds while lowering the melting temperature. The breakthrough could unlock entirely new glass materials with precisely controlled magnetic and optical properties, opening possibilities for advanced electronics, sensors, and other technologies.

items.t: 不是癌症卻同樣致命！耳朵痛癢伴隨臉歪嘴斜，當心致死率極高的「惡性外耳炎」
items.x: 「惡性外耳炎」並非癌症，而是致死率極高的嚴重耳道感染，細菌恐侵犯顱底與腦神經導致臉歪嘴斜。此病好發於高齡糖尿病患等免疫低下族群，若出現異常耳痛癢應盡速就醫。

items.t: 晶體中的微小缺陷揭示了巨大的量子驚喜
items.x: 研究人員解決了一個長期存在的挑戰，即了解鑽石和碳化矽等材料中的微小缺陷在光照下如何表現。他們的新計算方法揭示了碳化矽中一個令人驚訝的重要能量損失機制，而科學家之前卻低估了這個機制。這項發現有助於解釋多年來困擾研究人員的謎團，
items.orig: A tiny defect in a crystal reveals a big quantum surprise
items.origX: Researchers have solved a long-standing challenge in understanding how tiny defects in materials like diamond and silicon carbide behave when exposed to light. Their new computational method revealed a surprisingly important energy-loss mechanism in silicon carbide that scientists had previously underestimated. The finding helps explain a mystery that has puzzled researchers for years and could improve the design of quantum computers and sensors.

items.t: 霍亂細菌的善行：激發出具有稀有特性的膠水
items.x: 即使在水下也能牢固黏合的黏合劑的靈感來自一種可怕的病原體產生的蛋白質。

items.origX: An adhesive that binds strongly even under water was inspired by a protein made by a feared pathogen.

items.t: 麻省理工學院的科學家打破了 20 年的規則並解鎖了前所未見的晶體結構
items.x: 麻省理工學院的科學家挑戰了二十年來的傳統思維，發現靈活的分子連接，而不是剛性的分子連接，可以解鎖排列奈米顆粒的全新方法。這項突破可能會催生出具有不同尋常特性的新一代設計材料，並在電子、醫學和能源領域得到應用。
items.orig: MIT scientists break a 20-year rule and unlock never-before-seen crystal structures
items.origX: MIT scientists have challenged two decades of conventional thinking by discovering that flexible molecular connections, rather than rigid ones, can unlock entirely new ways to arrange nanoparticles. The breakthrough could lead to a new generation of designer materials with unusual properties and applications in electronics, medicine, and energy.

items.t: 氫衍生物使中國實現具有成本效益的碳中和
items.x: 政府間氣候變遷專門委員會建議1.5℃的碳減量目標，需要主要經濟體強而有力的執行。中國作為最大的二氧化碳排放國，在可變再生能源調節和難以減排產業的脫碳方面都面臨嚴峻的困難。氫作為連接再生能源與最終用戶的重要綠色能源載體，在發展方面面臨重大障礙
items.orig: Hydrogen Derivatives Enable Cost-Effective Carbon Neutrality in China
items.origX: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change recommended 1.5°C carbon reduction target, requiring powerful enforcement from major economies. China, the largest CO2 emitter, is facing severe difficulties for both variable renewable accommodation and decarbonization of hard-to-abate sectors. Hydrogen, as a critical green energy carrier bridging renewable to end-users, faces significant obstacles in real-world deployment such as costly transportation, storage and fuel-cell adoption. Affordable and coordinated hydrogen deployment plan to accelerate the carbon-neutral transition remains ambiguous. Here, we present cost-effective carbon-neutral transition pathways for entire energy economy of China emphasizing the significant role of hydrogen and derivatives as green energy carriers, considering high-resolution renewable deployments, hourly power system operations in 29 provincial regions, over 46,000 rail/road/marine/pipeline transfer routing of hydrogen derivatives, process-level fuel adoption strategies in all end-use sectors. Results show that incorporating hydrogen and derivatives can reduce the overall transition cost by $ 10.7 trillion compared with renewable and electrification pathways, achieving negative carbon abatement costs ($-6.15/ton), eliminating external oil import expenses, equivalent to over 50% of China trade surplus (2023 level)1, significantly boosting employment and economic growth. Hydrogen derivative based transition pathway offers a vital direction for affordable and secure decarbonization for China and beyond under volatile international energy markets.
